review_route.rationale: Critical-path supply-chain, confinement, lifecycle, and runtime-identity boundary.

submitted_candidate.artifact_set_formula: Sort artifacts by path. For each artifact concatenate path, one TAB byte, sha256 without a prefix, and one LF byte; SHA-256 the concatenation.

decisive_finding.summary: The exact submitted 20-path membership has the claimed line and byte counts but not the claimed aggregate digest.
decisive_finding.review_disposition: Substantive source, test, and adversarial review stopped at the identity gate.

highest_defensible_ceiling: Previously accepted distribution library APIs remain accepted. The new isolated identity-ladder behavior is an unaccepted corrected candidate only.
explicitly_withheld: actual marketplace, cache, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, or runtime proof
installation, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion
